script: Three world leaders sat in one city, and Hitler sent his best assassin to kill all three at once. In 1943, Churchill, Roosevelt, and Stalin met in Tehran, and German intelligence dispatched an elite team led by commando Otto Skorzeny, the same man who had rescued Mussolini in a daring glider raid. But here's the part nobody mentions, Soviet intelligence had already cracked the German radio network and was reading their messages in real time. Stalin moved the meetings into a heavily guarded embassy without saying why. The German team was rolled up before a single shot was fired. Hitler sent his best man to kill three leaders in one room, and never even got the chance to try.
